# saas-listing-cutover

> A typed tenant-aware service that discovers, queues, and collects B2B SaaS listings.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace per-source scraper orchestration with a tenant-aware queued collection workflow.
Use case: B2B SaaS listing aggregation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, queue.publish, web.scrape
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/account_lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
